narr: Scattered showers and storms developed across central and eastern Virginia on July 12 given an unstable air mass in place. These storms were slow-moving and produced heavy rain and flooding.
ev: Airport Drive at Richmond International Airport was flooded from heavy rain. A video showing the flooding was shared on social media.
Standing water was reported on Redington Drive.
A video on social media showed minor garage and yard flooding in King William.
Water was over the roadway with US-360 partially closed at the intersection of VA-647 and Hull Street Road.
A road was closed in the vicinity of Edenberry Drive due to standing water.
Water was reported over Ruffin Road.
Powhite Parkway exit ramp was closed due to standing water.
There were reports of multiple homes and vehicles at least partially submerged near Bon Air. Water rescue teams were deployed to assist affected residents.
Flooding was reported via mPING along the intersection of Waterfront Drive and Dunston Point Parkway.
Multiple reports of flooding on Temple Avenue near Dimmock Parkway were relayed via waze.
There were numerous reports of flooding via waze with water visible on the roadway via VDOT cameras in the vicinity of I-264 just east of the downtown tunnel.
There was a flooding report on mPING near the I-95 on-ramp.
The public reported flooding along Tidewater Drive near Cromwell Drive and on Norview Avenue via waze.

The Virginia Statewide Incidents page posted that a water rescue occurred on the 1900 block of Bainbridge Street. Fire crews were reported to be on scene with two boats deployed and crews rescuing one adult and two juveniles from a vehicle submerged in water up to the wheel wells. No injuries were reported at the time of the report.
The 911 call center reported standing water along Shady Grove Road. Time estimated from radar.
The 911 call center reported standing water along Atlee Road.
Broadcast media shared a picture of street flooding along Grove Avenue in Richmond. The picture showed several inches of water over the roadway.
Water was reported to be over the roadway at the intersection of Ellerson Farm Drive and Meadowbridge Road.
